name: The Barcelona EDITION
insider_take: This ultra-modern sanctuary in the heart of Barcelona's trendy El Born district puts you steps from the city's most authentic tapas bars and medieval charm.
whats_special: The Barcelona EDITION occupies a striking contemporary building designed by renowned architect Ricardo Bofill, featuring a dramatic rooftop pool with panoramic views of the Gothic Quarter. The hotel's location on Avinguda del Portal de l'Àngel places you on one of Europe's most walked pedestrian streets, with over 3,000 people passing by every hour.
pro_tip: Book a sunset cocktail at the rooftop terrace before 7 PM to secure the best tables overlooking the iconic spires of the Sagrada Família in the distance.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant helmed by a Michelin-starred chef serves modern Catalan cuisine, and you're just a 3-minute walk to the legendary Picasso Museum housed in five adjoining medieval palaces. The nearby Santa Caterina Market, with its stunning mosaic roof, offers the city's freshest local produce and artisanal goods.
pros: Prime location in Barcelona's vibrant city center
Contemporary luxury design with sophisticated amenities
Access to exclusive Marriott STARS Program benefits
cons: Urban setting may be busy for those seeking tranquility
